author: jsign
content:
> Why do we have a SszNewPayloadRequest and a NewPayloadRequest type in execution-specs?
`NewPayloadRequest` is the type for the data used in `StatelessInput` which is the input for guest program.  `SszNewPayloadRequest` (and `Ssz*` in general) are the corresponding `Ssz*` representations.
We need `NewPayloadRequest` in `execution-specs` since it is part of the input of the guest program.
(But maybe I'm missing something in your question)

author: jsign
content: Reg making it a progressive container, sounds good to me. Agree I would start proposing this change in CL first; if all is good, then we can change it in execution-specs
